## Relationships

### [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grandma-irving--mary-joe.md)

Grandma Irving acts as an employer to [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), holding authority over her and issuing commands. Their relationship is defined by this directive dynamic established in Volume 2.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P10](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0010)_

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grandma-irving--paul-irving.md)

Grandma Irving is the grandmother of [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). Their familial connection as grandmother and grandchild is established in Volume 2.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P3](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0003), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024), +1 more_

### [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grandma-irving--stephen-irving.md)
